description: Source code for the TA (Timing Advance) management system in a scheduler, handling UE contexts, timing commands, outlier detection, and interactions with logical channels.

classes.name: ta_management_system
classes.description: Manages Timing Advance (TA) for UEs, including adding/removing UEs, handling TA commands, and processing updates.

classes.name: ue_ta_manager
classes.description: Manages individual UE's Timing Advance state, including reset and cleanup.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context with specified parameters and updates tags.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the system and from the time wheel.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Processes a slot indication, handling measurement completion and clearing UEs from the wheel.

methods.name: handle_ue_ta_cmds
methods.description: Handles pending TA commands for a UE, sending MAC indications if needed.

methods.name: update_tags
methods.description: Updates the tag list for a UE, resetting related statistics.

methods.name: compute_new_t_a
methods.description: Calculates a new Timing Advance value based on the difference and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: compute_avg_n_ta_difference
methods.description: Computes the average N_TA difference from measurement window data.

methods.name: handle_ul_n_ta_update_indication
methods.description: Processes uplink N_TA update indications, including outlier detection and timing command updates.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the UE TA manager, removing the UE from the parent system.
